messages.content:
Hello!
15 YOE.

Worked at CVS, eBay, Florida Blue, DHSMV & others through consulting companies.

Actually more of a Developer turned Manager. 
I did people manage / project manage but didn't really highlight much of it up in my resume.
Hello 15 YOE, 5 as PM  worked in Amex FTE and contractor  applying for PM or Sr PM roles in faang and few more

Hello!
20 YOE, 7 as Technical PM

I’m getting ready to pursue jobs at some FAANGS. I have work at Apple in the past and interviewed with AWS (however VERY awkward situations and I’m trying to avoid this in the future).

I started building computers when I was 10, but I came to Product Management through the UX career path. I have some coding skills but I would never apply for a SDE position. I’ve been a manager of technical teams in the past. And I’m at the point in my career where I’m trying to decide if I want to go for L7 Principal IC or L7 Manager of PMs. 

I’m currently in a contract, which is set to end in October so I’m going to take the next few months to prep and get ready.
Interview experience - Amazon 1 phone screen cleared but they suggested TPM role for me and which didn’t go well

My last interview w/ AWS I was being interviewed by someone in the team (passed the screening - first intro with the team) and I asked him “where do you see yourself w/ AWS in the next 5 years” and he’s response “within 5 years I’d like to be a Product Manager” 😳.        This was after I just described my job and how I’ve been a product manager for the past 7 years.
Hello All, I am T.Arch with 14+ yrs experience, started giving interviews for TPM role .
Hello, TPM wanting to make the move to a PM soon. Excited to learn from this group.

👋 hey all — joining FAANG soon as a PM after 25 years as SDE, eng manager, and C-level. Going back to IC life, and looking forward to it. My C role was a lot of PM function. All at SMB. Looking forward to the big leagues.

Hey all - 12+ Years of TPM and Product management experience. I enjoy both the roles. I’m in a small midwest city worked with multiple fortune 500s. Looking for Remote only FAANG roles. I’m a efficiency freak.
Which Midwest city? Currently based 8n Austin looking to make a move to Midwest or southwest.
@NomadPM I’m in St Louis. The big city with a small town feeling. 20-30 mins drive to most places you need to go.
saint louis? nah thanks!

Which is the best product roadmap tool?
How about productboard ??

Hello everyone,
Just joined recently. I am currently a graduate student that will be interning as a TPM this year for Tiktok. Looking forward to learning more about being a better tpm/pm and getting general career advice from y'all
Welcome!  Are you looking for Technical Product Management? Or Technical Program Management?
Interning at TikTok sounds fun! Wish I could do internships 😍

This will be a technical program management internship as there were no product mgr titled internships. The internship seems pretty open ended where i can learn some skills that can be applied towards either pm or tpm role. I'll have a better idea of what full time path once the internship is completed.

Still sounds fun. Most of us this little group are Product Managers or aspiring Product Managers. There are other channels in here that are solely for TPMs and Program Manager…. Not that we don’t want you here 🙂, we just might not have all the insight that you are looking for. But welcome to the Party 🥳
@jdai will this internship be your first time in the job world?
i was working for a couple years prior to entering my graduate program. i have some experience as a developer and BA.
Hello All !  Greetings! This is Senthil , joined in today  ..Agile Delivery lead / TPM + Product Management Experience , Based out of Dallas / TX.  Good to be here !
having Technical BackGround
Dallas here !!

Hello I’ve been around this server for a bit.

Currently I’m a SWE intern at Microsoft, and will be joining Atlassian as an APM later this summer. 

Remote based out of Northern California.

Feel free to dm for referrals for msft, although not sure the weight it will have lol. And if you’re reading this in September onward, dm me for Atlassian.

Hello Everyone.  I am a high school graduate with no secondary degree, with 3 years of Project Management Experience in the Tradeshow Event Industry and 1 year in the Construction industry.  I am looking for an opportunity to transition into the tech industry as a Technical Project Manager, IT project manager, or Program manager.

Does anyone have any advise or can provide help in what certs I should look for, or actions to take to make my way into these industries?

Amazon, try applying for roles there. Transition after a year or two working. These would likely be on-site roles, area manager, data center techs, etc. that would be my advice if you have no interest in going back to school

I would recommend trying to join a start up, look on angellist. Your challenge is getting through the resume filtering system and recruiters, so maybe applying at very small companies may give you a better chance
Great Idea!  Angellist huh?  Will start with that!
Hi hellodisco! Sorry to hear that you were laid off.   Where in the Bay area are you looking to move specifically?
Gotcha. I live in the Seattle area but I’m originally from the Bay Area (and I visit OFTEN) and also I’m now living part-time in NYC!
Super jealous of that!  Sounds fun 🤩
Hello All, I am currently working as TPM and looking for a change.  I started my preparation to get into some good company. Anybody here to give 1:1 guidance?
Hi all, a PM with a software company with 4 years experience managing contact center applications. Looking for a PM role in a new company.

Hi all
I’m currently a Sr PM at Aerospace company. I’m currently managing people, finance, product and customer. Is this normal?
Are you managing people who are specialized in those areas and do they report to you? It sounds like a lot

@cereal Technically, I don’t have anyone officially reporting to me, but when work dried up, I found work for them in other team. When project money dries up, I’m the one going to meeting to beg for more money. Also, managing customer’s expectation. When there was an issue in the project I had to resolve it and keep the customer happy. All these thing on top of normal product duties. It’s like I’m better off having my own business!

Hey all! Recently laid off from Meta, using this re-direction to potentially pivot to what I love doing- Product. Looking forward to learning from this group- any recommendation/tips on where/how to get started>

Has anyone taken courses using Udemy to get advance your skill sets? What courses have you taken? Does the courses help you show your knowledge on your skill sets? I see AI might be a good market to get into. Any recommendations to get into AI TPM or product management?

Hey Guys 

Is PMP certification  & Domain Knowledge mandatory ?

I would hardly consider it mandatory, but it’s definitely a differentiator. I’ve often found myself in a position where I’m pulling tools from pmbok and am teaching it to more junior TPMs or stakeholders. Same with SAFe. Everyone hates it but then when you teach them the tools and processes they love it 😜

I constantly am taking Udemy courses to understand new tech stacks or role specific tech teams are working on. Also to learn about the more technical configurations of tools like Jira/GitHub actions or whatever. CI/CD stuff, and learning fancy ways to leverage notion. I’ve never considered trying to use certs or evidence of completing these for self promotion I actually suspect they’d have the opposite effect and make me appear less experienced 😅

I have taken AWS amd Terrform courses from Udemy due to personal interest. From resume perspective I don’t think completing udemy/LinkedIn courses matters much unless you use the knowledge on live projects and/or complete industry standard certification which can be a differentiatior.

Hey Ya’ll. PM at Meta here 🙏🏼

Looking to help folks wanting to get into Meta. I can help with Mocks

Hi there! I'm a PM with 8+ YOE. Currently interviewing because of layoffs. 
Any Meta PMs that can help with mocks? I'd really appreciate it!

Hi All, 
I want to know more about technical Program manager role at Microsoft what is all about and what do they expect.
Sorry, did you get the info you were looking for?
Hi @AG I got some insight. Still looking for what a day to day looks like
Tagging @paytun again 🙂
Well I got rejected sooo won’t matter now 😦
But thank you so much !! 🙂

Hello! 

The TPM role across Microsoft will differ, I'm happy to have a virtual coffee with you and talk a bit about what TPMs do in the org that I work within.  The larger side of the company with the Product Groups, normally the TPMs I've worked with have a lot of technical depth in their focus areas.  While I don't think they will test you with a coding interview, your architecture skills will definitely be a key part of the technical interview. 

Feel free to DM me the job ID you're considering, and if I know more or can find out more, will try to give you any insights.
